reason: A settings-page analytics plugin that aggregates persisted DeepSeek Harness session logs and presents token usage through dashboards, charts, rankings, and data exports.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页汇总并可视化会话 Token 用量，提供指标卡、热力图、模型与提供商统计、会话排行及 JSON/CSV 导出。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings-page plugin that aggregates and visualizes session token usage with KPI cards, heatmaps, model and provider breakdowns, session rankings, and JSON/CSV exports.

capabilities: Reads persisted session logs to aggregate token-usage statistics
Displays usage metrics, activity heatmaps, model/provider breakdowns, and session rankings
Exports aggregated statistics as JSON and CSV files
Caches aggregated results in browser localStorage and through a loopback RPC endpoint
